channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Athletic Grounds to host re-fixture as Ulster club SFC final is pushed back
item.description: The BOX-IT Athletic Grounds will host the Ulster club SFC semi-final re-fixture between Scotstown and Newbridge next Sunday at 4pm.

item.title: The Championship 2025 by Brian Carthy is out now
item.description: Gaelic Games commentator, journalist and author, Brian Carthy reflects on the 2025 Football and Hurling Championships in his comprehensive book, which contains the results of every single game in both senior codes.

item.title: 'He'd be on any inter-county panel'
item.description: Jimmy Barry-Murphy was singing Brian Hayes' praises after his five-star display for St Finbarr's against Éire Óg, Ennis.

item.title: Donnellan returns to Breaffy management team
item.description: Former Galway forward John Donnellan has rejoined the Breaffy management team ahead of the 2026 season.

item.title: 'He's a sucker for punishment'
item.description: Pat Spillane is baffled as to why Ephie Fitzgerald has agreed to take charge of the Waterford footballers for a second time.

item.title: Irish quintet make AFLW All-Australian team
item.description: A record five Irish players have been named in this year's All-Australian AFLW team.

item.title: Bonner switches focus to Fermanagh job after Erne Gaels exit
item.description: Declan Bonner was already turning his thoughts towards managing Fermanagh after his tenure as Erne Gaels boss ended with an Ulster club SFC semi-final defeat to Kilcoo last Saturday.

item.title: Ballyshannon and Letterkenny to host Donegal's 'home' League games
item.description: With MacCumhaill Park in Ballybofey unavailable due to pitch improvement works, Ballyshannon's Fr Tierney Park and O'Donnell Park in Letterkenny will host Donegal's three 'home' matches in next year's Allianz Football League.

item.title: McMahon takes over Omagh St Enda's
item.description: Former All Star, All-Ireland winner and double O'Neill cup winner in Tyrone Justin McMahon has been appointed the new senior manager of home town club Omagh St Enda's.

item.title: 'Dirty belt' on Mullen still rankles with Shefflin
item.description: Henry Shefflin is still annoyed over the 'dirty belt' which looks set to rule Adrian Mullen out of the remainder of Ballyhale Shamrocks' club campaign.
